infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: PocketAI reads selected health data locally to provide offline insights.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: PocketAI does not write health data. This permission is included only if required by the native library.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: PocketAI reads calendar events locally to show upcoming events and schedule local reminders.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: PocketAI reads calendar events locally to show upcoming events and schedule local reminders.
infoPlist.NSRemindersUsageDescription: PocketAI does not use reminders directly. This permission is required by the native calendar module to initialize safely.
infoPlist.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: PocketAI does not use reminders directly. This permission is required by the native calendar module to initialize safely.
